fluff.overview: Most Clusters in Clan Hell's Horses deploy a number of ad hoc Points that lack the specialization of dedicated formations. The Forty-second BattleMech Cluster, Theta Galaxy, is typical: its ad hoc foot Points are armed with modern Gauss sub machineguns and automatic grenade launchers, making them quite capable in a firefight despite their lack of formal role assignment. Made up of tested-down warriors drawn from all branches who failed to qualify for more prestigious postings, these solahma troops are not expected to live long. They are motivated less by honor than by the chance to see combat one last time. Combat reports from the Clan Wolf Occupation Zone suggest that Wolf commanders preferred to use Elementals for headhunting missions specifically targeting the conventional support units that formations like the Forty-second's infantry routinely protect.
